title: Reviewing Status Actions (Inbound & Outbound)

children:
Status actions determine how a receipt or shipment is managed when a 
 unique circumstance occurs, such as a shipment is added from the Shipment 
 Insight screen. You can review/change these on either the Inbound (receipts) 
 or Outbound (shipments) Status Action Window.

If you select the outbound 
 status    Delete Rejected for a 
 status action, the system will delete record(s) that meet this status. 
 For example, if you select it for the    Rejected 
 Shipments status action, the system will delete the rejected shipment's 
 quantity completely from the system.

When the outbound status action for reject shipments is "Delete Shipments," and BOM action is "Create WO For Rejected Shipment," then shipments are treated like the shipments are treated in the "In Pool" action.

WARNING:   Two outbound status actions support a status 
 value called Complete 
 Rejection to Pool. For this status, 
 the system, during partial rejections of a shipment, will reject the quantity 
 (similar to what is done in the Delete 
 Rejected outbound status action status). 
 Once the entire quantity on a shipment has been rejected, then the system 
 sends the shipment back to the pool, with all of its original quantities 
 restored. Note that this status can be used only by the Reject 
 Shipment and Short 
 Pick outbound status actions.

Access the inbound or outbound status action window. The record list 
 displays all of the default status actions. You can also create new ones.

Open the appropriate 
 record. If appropriate, change the description associated with 
 this record.

Use the System Status Field to 
 review or change the status assigned to the receipt or shipment when the 
 event identified occurs.

Press OK. 
 The system will save your changes.

Default Status When Check In Is Cancelled 
 - Indicates the default status when the check-in action for an item quantity 
 is cancelled.

Default Status When Adding A Receipt 
 - Indicates the default status when a receipt is manually added from the 
 Receipt Insight screen(i.e. the receipt was not interfaced to the system).

Default Status When Adding A Receipt 
 Container - The default status when a container is added on either 
 the Receipt Insight screen or the Receipt Workbench Window

Default Status When Locating Is Cancelled 
 - The default status when the locating action for an item is cancelled.

Default Status For A Container With 
 No Detail - The default status when a container ID is interfaced 
 with a shipment number, but not a shipment line number. The system associates 
 the container ID with its shipment, not a detail record. Also, this could 
 occur if you were to delete all the details from a container, and thus 
 would have an empty container.

Default Status When Added In Order 
 Entry - The default status when a shipment is added to the system 
 from the order entry module.

Default Status When Added From Shipping- The default status when a shipment is added on the Shipment 
 Insight screen (i.e. the shipment was not interfaced to the system).

Default Status When Added From Wave
 -The default status when a shipment is added to the pool on the Planned Shipment Insight screen (i.e. the shipment was not interfaced to the system).

Default Status When Shipment Is Canceled 
 - The default status when a shipment is added to a wave, but then removed 
 before the wave was run.

Default Status When Shipment Is Rejected 
 - The default status when a shipment is rejected during a wave. Note that the deletion of work instructions also honors this outbound status action, and that this setting is for work tied to outbound shipments only.

Default Status Of Short Picked/Short Putaway Portion 
 Of Shipment - The default status when a portion OR all of a shipment's 
 item quantity is not picked/putaway completely.
